_note: Static piece (docs/ART-REDO.md section 3, map table). The concept has no table, so the box is the theme.jpg house for its timber colours. The live mesh is a box 36x8x22 centred at y=8, so the top is near y=12, and the cloth plane sits at y=13.2. world height 16 (44 px) is that top plus a little of the tabletop in a three-quarter view: half a hero (32), under the trap (20) and the forge (36). Cell 160x56 holds a table about three times as wide as it is tall, the 40-wide cloth. The cloth is blank. The chunk map stays painted on top in the engine.
source_note: The reference shows no table: it is a village house; draw only one wooden table and nothing else, no house, no figures; use the reference only for the colours of its timber
design: a low rectangular table of dark timber with four square legs and a plain warm-brown cloth draped over the top, the cloth blank, with no map, no marks, no writing and no symbols

variants.note: the long side and one end toward the camera, the cloth hanging a little over the near edge, the top of the cloth empty
